samples.rationale: Clinician review of current medications against documented primary diagnoses and allergies to ensure therapeutic appropriateness and identify any contraindications or drug-allergy conflicts.
This extraction retrieves the patient's current medications, primary diagnosis, and allergies to enable safe clinical review for care coordination purposes.
Reviewing current medications against patient diagnoses and allergies is essential for care coordination and ensuring medication safety as part of direct patient care provision.

This extraction retrieves the patient's current medications, primary diagnosis, and allergies to enable comprehensive medication review and care coordination. The data supports clinical decision-making to ensure medication appropriateness and safety for the patient's condition.

Medication review requires current medication list, primary diagnosis, and allergies to ensure therapeutic appropriateness and safety. Data retained for active care episodes with automated purge on purpose completion.

Extraction identifies patients with upcoming appointments and retrieves their contact details and appointment times to deliver reminder notifications. This directly supports the scheduling and appointment management functions for which patients provided their registration data.

Appointment reminders require patient contact information and scheduling details to fulfill the patient's registration and scheduling needs. Direct identifiers must be retained to enable patient contact.

Extract contact information and scheduled appointment details to enable sending appointment reminders to patients as part of the registration and scheduling services disclosed in privacy notice NOTICE-REG-2026.

Patient identifiers and contact information are necessary to deliver appointment reminders as part of the patient registration and scheduling service. This processing is aligned with the purpose for which patients provided their data.

This extraction enables the hospital to send appointment reminders, fulfilling a core service delivery function for which patients provided their contact and scheduling data at registration. Processing is lawful under the legitimate use basis as it directly supports the provision of medical services.

Data extracted to reconcile outstanding invoice with payer and cross-check billing charges against patient's primary diagnosis, enabling the accounts team to verify clinical justification and complete settlement.

Enable accounts team to reconcile outstanding invoice with payer and verify charges against patient's diagnosis for billing settlement. Processing is lawfully based on legitimate use for the stated billing settlement purpose.
Accounts team requires invoice details, payer information, and patient diagnosis to reconcile outstanding charges with payer and verify clinical justification for billed amounts.

This extraction reconciles an outstanding invoice with payer records and clinical data to verify that charges correspond to the patient's documented diagnosis and encounter. All applicable transport, encryption, access, and audit controls are enabled to secure this sensitive financial and clinical information.

Registration requires direct identifiers and contact details to establish the patient record and verify insurance policy coverage and payer for service authorization.

Walk-in registration requires patient demographics and identification for the MRN record; insurance policy number and payer details are captured to document coverage for billing and care coordination.

Clinical summary required for the care team to coordinate ongoing patient care and ensure continuity of medical services aligned with the lawful basis for provision of care.

To identify current inpatients, their assigned wards, and when they were last clinically seen, supporting real-time care coordination and clinical handover.

This extraction provides real-time ward census data for care coordination by linking current patient admissions to their most recent clinical encounters. Direct identifiers are required for clinicians to know which patient to assess.

Extracting current ward assignments and most recent encounter times to enable care coordination staff to locate and manage patients on each ward.

Extract current diagnosis and allergies for consultant-led care coordination. Data retained for one year to support ongoing clinical management and specialist referrals.

Extract current diagnosis and allergy information to support consultant-led care coordination and continuity of clinical management, retained for one year per clinical practice requirements.

Invoice reconciliation with payer for billing settlement. Clinical diagnosis and medication included per DPO authorization to support audit of billing against services provided.
